courses.address: Bristol Rd (gravel lot next to the GM Flint Processing Center), Swartz Creek, MI 48473
courses.status: Under construction — all 18 holes playable, signed, arrows under each basket to the next tee

hole_notes.10: Basket is through a small gap across the drainage. Use the man bridge near the hole 8 tee pad to cross while the new path is built.
hole_notes.14: Walk through the woods along the hill from the 13 basket.
hole_notes.16: Long hole along the hill on the east (GM) side; finishes near the base of the hill. Follow the path to the top of the hill for the 17 tee.
hole_notes.17: Throw from the top of the hill across the drainage and over the trees to the bottom of the sled hill, behind and below the 18 tee. Walk up the hill to 18.

courses.signed_order_note: Course signage runs 2-9, then 1, then 10-18; Will plays 1-18 in order.
